tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run several commands in order, stopping at the first error. Returns each result; on failure also the failing index and message (earlier commands stay applied; use edit.undo to revert them). Later steps can use earlier results: a parameter string "$N.path" is replaced by that value of step N's result (0-based; "$last.path" for the previous step), e.g. after frame.create → {"id": 8, "story": 9}, {"story": "$0.story"} passes 9; "${N.path}" interpolates into longer strings. Other strings starting with $ stay as written; "$$" is a literal $ ("$$1" passes the GREP group $1). Give `commands`, or `script` text (one `command.id {json}` per line).

params.description: Command parameters (see the `params` field of list_commands)

script.description: Alternative to `commands`: lines of `command.id {json params}` (# comments allowed)

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at a screen point (egui points, top-left of the window = 0,0) through the real pointer path: reaches menus, panels, flyouts and dialogs. Find coordinates with ui_inspect and screenshot. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: dialog_cancel
tools.description: Press Cancel in the open dialog. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: dialog_confirm
tools.description: Press OK in the open dialog. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: dialog_set
tools.description: Set a field of the open dialog (see ui_inspect → dialog for its fields). Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Press at (x, y), move to (toX, toY) in `steps` moves and release, in screen points through the real pointer path. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run any DesignCraft command by id with JSON params (ids and params from list_commands). Examples: {"command":"frame.create","params":{"rect":[36,36,576,300],"content":"text","text":"Hello"}} → {id, story}; {"command":"type.char","params":{"size":24}}; {"command":"edit.undo"}. Coordinates are points in spread space. In the desktop app the UI-only commands (view.*, window.*, help.*, edit.dynamicSpelling, and app.* except app.links, which works everywhere) work too.

params.description: Command parameters (see the `params` field of list_commands)

tools.name: export_png
tools.description: Export one page as a PNG (or JPEG if the path ends in .jpg) file. Returns the path and pixel size.

page.description: Page index, 0-based: page 0 exports the first page (the same page is position 1 in file.exportPdf's pages; default 0; in the desktop app default = the current page)

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Full text of a story plus its length, frames, paragraph count, line count and overset position (length and positions are UTF-8 byte offsets, the unit text.select takes). Identify it by `story` id or by a text `frame` id (default: the selection).

tools.name: ime
tools.description: Input method (IME) events at the Type tool's caret, as a system IME sends them: `preedit` is the marked text (shown in place, no undo step; an empty string cancels the composition), `active` the clause being converted in characters of it, `commit` the text the IME types in its place (one undo step). Example, Japanese: {preedit:"にほん", active:[3,3]} then {preedit:"日本", active:[0,2]} then {commit:"日本"}. Returns whether a composition is still open.

active.description: [start, end] of the clause being converted, in characters of preedit (start = end: the IME's cursor)

commit.description: Committed text, typed in place of the marked text

preedit.description: Marked text (replaces the previous marked text; empty = cancel)

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Summary of the active document: settings, pages (index, name, bounds, margins, columns), spreads with items (id, kind, bounds, fill, stroke, story), stories (id, frames, length in UTF-8 bytes, overset, preview), layers, paragraph/character styles, swatches, selection, active tool.

tools.name: key
tools.description: Press a key with modifiers, e.g. {key:"Z", cmd:true} (undo), {key:"Escape"}, {key:"Enter"}, {key:"Left", shift:true}. In the desktop app it goes through the real keyboard path; headless it goes to the active tool (caret keys while typing), then command shortcuts, then tool shortcuts.

key.description: Key name: A–Z, 0–9, Enter, Escape, Delete, Backspace, Tab, Space, Left/Right/Up/Down, Home, End, [ ] …

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: List DesignCraft commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter description and whether it can run right now. Every user-visible action is a command (frame.create, text.insert, type.char, style.paragraph.apply, layout.pages.insert, object.fill, transform.move, edit.undo…); run them with execute or batch.

enabledOnly.description: Only commands that can run right now

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against id, label and menu path (e.g. "frame", "style", "Layout")

tools.name: menu_list
tools.description: The menu bar tree (menus, entries as cmd:/ui: command ids, separators, submenus). Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: new_document
tools.description: Create a new document and make it active. Sizes are in points (72 pt = 1 in). sample:true opens the multi-page magazine sample instead.

bleed.description: Bleed on all sides (pt) or [top, bottom, inside, outside]

margins.description: Uniform margin (pt) or {top, bottom, inside, outside}

primaryTextFrame.description: Put a primary text frame on the parent page

slug.description: Slug on all sides (pt) or [top, bottom, inside, outside]

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open a .designcraft file as a new, active document.

tools.name: place_image
tools.description: Place an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF) from a file `path` or `base64` data. It goes into `frame` (or the selected empty/graphic frame), otherwise into a new frame at x, y (default: the page's top-left margin) with an optional width.

spread.description: Spread index for a new frame (default 0)

width.description: Width of the new frame (pt); height follows the aspect ratio

x.description: Left of the new frame (spread pt)

y.description: Top of the new frame (spread pt)

tools.name: pointer
tools.description: Drive the active tool with mouse events, exactly like the mouse would. Coordinates are spread points (space "doc", default) or, in the desktop app, screen points (space "screen"). Example: a text frame with the type tool: {tool:"type", events:[{kind:"down",x:72,y:72},{kind:"drag",x:300,y:200},{kind:"up",x:300,y:200}]} leaves a caret in the new frame, ready for type_text. Returns the selection and the active tool.

clicks.description: On a down: presses in a row it completes (2 double, 3 triple…; default 1)

mods.description: Modifier keys held (cmd = Command on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere; alt = Option)
Modifier keys held (cmd = Command on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere; alt = Option)

tool.description: Optional tool to select before the gesture

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render one page of the active document (printing items only, like Preview) and return it as a PNG image. Optionally also write it to `path`.

page.description: Page index, 0-based: page 0 renders the first page (the same page is position 1 in file.exportPdf's pages; default 0; in the desktop app default = the current page)

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the active document in the native .designcraft format.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the whole app window (menus, panels, canvas) and return it as a PNG image. Optionally also keep it at `path`. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: select_tool
tools.description: Switch the active tool (as clicking it in the Tools panel). Ids: selection, directSelection, type, rectangleFrame, ellipseFrame, polygonFrame, rectangle, ellipse, polygon, line, hand, zoom, …

tools.name: set_story_text
tools.description: Replace the whole text of a story (keeps the first paragraph's and character's formatting). Use \n for paragraph breaks. Identify the story by `story` id or by a text `frame` id.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text at the text insertion point, independently of the active tool, or into the focused dialog field in the desktop app. Put a caret first with pointer (tool "type") or execute text.placeCaret / text.select.

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: UI state: active tool, panels, view (zoom, origin), canvas rect in screen points, window size, documents, open dialog, perf. Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: ui_set
tools.description: Change UI state: panel to open or close, brightness, status text, rulers/guides/frameEdges/baselineGrid/documentGrid/textThreads, Control bar, dock expanded, screenMode, zoom, page (1-based), fit (page|spread). Desktop app only (`designcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

closePanel.description: Close the panel that is showing

dockExpanded.description: Expand the panel dock (false: icons only)

panel.description: Panel: properties, pages, layers, swatches, paragraphStyles, characterStyles, stroke, character, paragraph, textWrap, links
